na + pāpuṇitvā

examples.text: appaṭivānī sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, padahāmi, kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
atha kho āyasmā bākulo aparena samayena apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āha, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto. ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
ete tayo devamanussaseṭṭhā, pabhaṅ'karā dhammam'udīrayantā, apāpuranti amatassa dvāraṃ, yogā pamocenti hujjanaṃ te.
pāturahosi magadhesu pubbe, dhammo asuddho samalehi cintito, apāpur'etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, suṇantu dhammaṃ vimalen'ānubuddhaṃ.

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, pāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.
hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tassa mahānirayassa puratthimaṃ dvāraṃ apāpurīyati.

6612.meaning1: not a chain; not a necklace

examples.text: nikatī'ti yogavasena vā māyāvasena vā apāmaṅgaṃ pāmaṅgan'ti, amaṇiṃ maṇin'ti, asuvaṇṇaṃ suvaṇṇan'ti katvā patirūpakena vañcanaṃ.

6613.meaning1: state of loss; state of misery
6613.meaning2: hell, state of loss and woe
6613.commentary: (ANa) apāyo'ti niraya-tiracchānayoni-pettivisaya-asurakāyā. sabbe'pi hi te vaḍḍhisaṅkhātassa āyassa abhāvato apāyā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu?
ayaṃ varāko kiñ'c'āpi idāni sukhito susajjito bhoge paribhuñjati, atha kho tīsu dvāresu ekenā'pi katassa kalyāṇakammassa abhāvā idāni apāyesu anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedissatī'ti.
tasmā piyaṃ na kayirātha, piya-apāyo hi pāpako, ganthā tesaṃ na vijjanti, yesaṃ n'atthi piy'āppiyaṃ

6615.synonym: parabhāva, parābhava, byaya, vaya, vibhava, vyaya
6615.commentary: (DNt) yaṃ vā rucī'ti vuccati yehi surāpān'ādīhi bhogā apenti vigacchanti, tesu tesaṃ apāyesu byasanahetūsu sahāyo hoti.

examples.text: añña'd'atthuharo mitto, yo ca mitto vacīparo, anuppiyañ'ca yo āha, apāyesu ca yo sakhā.

6617.commentary: (VISM) apāyo'ti pana avuddhi, sā'pi duvidhā atthahānito ca anatth'uppattito ca. tattha kosallaṃ apāyakosallaṃ. yath'āha tattha katamaṃ apāyakosallaṃ? ime dhamme manasikaroto anuppannā c'eva kusalā dhammā na uppajjantī'ti-ādi (vibha. 771).

examples.text: tīṇi kosallāni, āyakosallaṃ, apāyakosallaṃ, upāyakosallaṃ.
bhūmiṃ gato bhūmigato, sabbarattiṃ sobhaṇo sabbarattisobhaṇo. apāyaṃ gato apāyagato, issarena kataṃ issarakataṃ, sallena viddho sallaviddho, kathinassa dussaṃ kathinadussaṃ

6619.meaning1: which leads to states of misery
6619.commentary: (PMa) apāyagamanīyo'ti niraya-tiracchānayoni-pettivisay'āsurakāyā cattāro sukhasaṅkhātā ayā apetattā apāyā, yassa saṃvijjati, taṃ puggalaṃ apāye gametī'ti apāyagamanīyo.

6620.meaning2: leading to perdition, to an unhappy state; liable to perdition

6621.meaning2: going or conveying to the state of misery

6623.meaning1: hell, bad destinations and the underworld
6623.commentary: (DNa) apāyo'ti niraya-tiracchānayoni-pettivisaya-asurakāyā. sabbe'pi hi te vaḍḍhisaṅkhātassa ayassa abhāvato, apāyo'ti vuccanti. tathā dukkhassa gatibhāvato duggati. sukhasamussayato vinipatitattā vinipāto.

examples.text: so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇa-apāyaduggativinipāto, sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.

6626.meaning1: plane of misery; state of suffering
6626.commentary: (KVt) tāsu nirayo tiracchānayoni pettivisayo asurakāyo ce'ti apāyabhūmi catubbidhā hoti.

examples.text: ye keci buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatāse, na te gamissanti apāyabhūmiṃ, pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ, devakāyaṃ paripūressantī'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, jambālī anekavassagaṇikā. tassā puriso yāni c'eva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya. evañ'hi tassā, bhikkhave, jambāliyā na āḷippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.

6628.meaning1: cause of ruin; path of failure

examples.text: imāya kho, ambaṭṭha, anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya cattāri apāyamukhāni bhavanti. katamāni cattāri?

yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.

6629.meaning1: companion in downfall; friend in ruin
6629.meaning2: companion in downfall; friend in loss

examples.text: surāmeraya majjappamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge sahāyo hoti, vikāla visikhā cariy'ānuyoge sahāyo hoti, samajj'ābhicaraṇe sahāyo hoti, jūtappamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge sahāyo hoti. imehi kho, gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo'ti.
atha kho bhagavā pānīyaṃ apāyi.
tasmiṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, saṅgāme asurā jiniṃsu, devā parājiniṃsu. parājitā ca kho, bhikkhave, devā apāyaṃsv'eva uttarenamukhā, abhiyaṃsv'eva ne asurā.
yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

examples.text: api ca me, āvuso, satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. etañ'hi, āvuso, sāvakassa patirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatī'ti, evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, dhārehī'ti.

tañ'ca naṃ purisaṃ amittato'pi daheyya, paccatthikato'pi daheyya, api ca jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya, dīgharattaṃ vata, bho, ahaṃ iminā purisena telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena nikato vañcito paluddho, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti.

6688.grammar: abs of na pīḷeti, neg, trans (+acc)
6688.meaning1: having not crushed; having not subjugated; having not oppressed
6688.construction:
na > a + pīḷe + tvā
na + pīḷetvā

examples.text: kālena kālaṃ rājānaṃ passituṃ āgacchantā aññassa rajjaṃ apīḷetvā attano attano rajjapadesen'eva āgamissanti c'eva gamissanti ca

6689.grammar: prp of na pīḷeti, neg, trans (+acc)
6689.meaning1: not oppressing; not crushing; not subjugating

examples.text: dhaññaṃ yebhuyyena attano gharaṃ pavesetvā appakaṃ rājakule paveseti. kiṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ na pīḷaṃ akāsī'ti ca vutto, āma, mahārāja, imasmiṃ vāre khettāni mandasassāni ahesuṃ, tasmā apīḷentassa me gaṇhato na bahuṃ jātan'ti evaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatike nissāya rājānaṃ vilumpati.

6690.meaning2: 'the not being like a rotten egg', soundness
6690.construction:
na > a + pūti > pūty > pucc + aṇḍa + tā
apuccaṇḍa + tā

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako sekho pāṭipado apucc'aṇḍatāya samāpanno, bhabbo abhinibbhidāya, bhabbo sambodhāya, bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.

6691.meaning1: non-question; question which should not be asked

examples.text: idān'āhaṃ, āvuso, bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etam'atthaṃ apucchiṃ. bhagavā'pi me etehi akkharehi etehi padehi etehi byañjanehi etam'atthaṃ byākāsi, seyyathā'pi āyasmā sāriputto.
sādh'āvuso'ti kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.

6694.meaning1: should not be asked; could not be asked

examples.text: paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.

6695.grammar: abs of na pucchati, neg, ditrans (+acc & +acc)

6696.grammar: aor 1st sg of apucchi, irreg form of apucchiṃ, ditrans (+acc & +acc)
6696.commentary: (NIDD2) dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissan'ti so brāhmaṇo dvikkhattuṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi. tassa bhagavā pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi, tadantarā imassa brāhmaṇassa indriyaparipāko bhavissatī'ti.

examples.text: dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.
dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati
atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

6698.commentary: (DNa) apuñño ca so abhisaṅkhāro cā'ti apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro. dvādasa-akusalacitta-sampayuttānaṃ cetanānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. vuttam'pi c'etaṃ tattha katamo apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro? akusalacetanā kām'āvacarā, ayaṃ vuccati apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro'ti.

examples.text: tattha katame avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā? puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro, apuñña-abhisaṅkhāro, āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro, kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro.

6699.meaning1: unmeritorious; related to demerit; connected with bad deeds
6699.construction:
na > a + puñña + bhāga + iya
apuññabhāga + iya

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāmayamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko.
